items.title: Midday to candlelit
items.note: The hardest edit in this family is not the wardrobe, it is the light: hard midday sun turned into candles on a balcony rail at night, which means new shadow directions on the face, a dark sea and a starfield where a blue sky was. Pose, framing, rail and flowerpots are all named as unchanged, so only time of day and one garment are allowed to move.

input.prompt: Keep the woman, her pose at the railing, the balcony, the iron rail and the geranium pots exactly as they are, and keep the same framing and camera angle. Change the time of day from hard midday sun to late night: the sky becomes deep blue-black with stars, the sea goes dark, and the whole scene is now lit only by a cluster of candles standing along the balcony rail, so warm amber candlelight rakes across her from below and everything else falls into deep shadow. Change her white cotton sundress to a black silk slip dress. Keep her face and body identical.

items.title: Three LoRAs stacked on one slow satin turn
items.alt: A woman in a champagne satin wrap turns in a dark gilded room; the fabric slips off one shoulder and her bare back catches the gold key light.
items.note: Three of your own LoRAs stacked in a single call — style, fabric and lighting — which is the ceiling `loras` accepts. Stacking is where LoRAs interfere: a fabric weight and a lighting weight both want the same highlights, so the brief keeps the action to one turn and lets the surfaces do the work. `duration_seconds` is 5 or 8 here and nothing in between, so choose it before you weight anything.

input.prompt: With all three LoRAs stacked - style, fabric and lighting - she turns on the spot and the satin catches the dark gold key light. The satin slides off one shoulder as she turns, the dark gold key raking the bare back. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.

items.title: Gothic sorceress rises from a candlelit throne
items.alt: Candle flames sway across a crypt as a painted elven sorceress lifts her hand from a stone armrest, turns toward camera and a sheer lace sleeve slides down her forearm, embers drifting upward.
items.note: The base model on its own, with no LoRA attached. For a painterly look or any other style, add a LoRA file URL to loras.

input.prompt: The candle flames gutter and sway across the crypt as she lifts her hand from the armrest, turns her head toward camera and the sheer lace sleeve slides down her forearm, embers drifting upward through the frame. Slow push-in, deep crimson and obsidian, low choral drone.

items.title: Airbrushed pool illustration that stays flat when it moves
items.alt: A flat airbrush-style illustration of a woman in a black bikini sitting at the edge of a neon-lit rooftop pool, pushing her wet hair back as the water ripples.
items.note: No LoRA at all, so what you are looking at is the base model holding a flat airbrushed print look for five seconds: banded gradient shading, halftone and print grain, while the water ripples and neon reflections wobble. Run this before any sweep — it is the baseline your LoRA results have to beat.

input.prompt: The illustration comes alive while keeping its flat airbrushed print look: the pool water ripples and laps at her legs, the neon arcs pulse and their reflections wobble across the surface, water keeps running off her hair and shoulders. She lowers her chin from the sky, opens her eyes and turns her face toward the viewer, then draws one hand up out of the water and slowly pushes her wet hair back off her shoulder. Gentle slow push in, banded gradient shading, halftone and print grain held stable throughout, black bikini stays on, no drift toward photorealism.

items.title: Extend a clip eight more seconds with the same LoRAs
items.alt: The satin wrap falls away as the woman turns from the gold light and walks off with her bare back to the camera, continuing the earlier clip for eight more seconds.
items.note: A continuation only works if the look continues too, so this call re-attaches the same LoRA set through the same `loras`, `high_noise_loras` and `low_noise_loras` fields rather than inheriting them from the clip. `video_url` names the clip being extended, and the prompt covers only the new seconds — here, movement starting out of a hold. Another 5 or 8 seconds per call, so a longer piece is built by repeating the step.

input.prompt: She turns away from the light and the satin falls off the other shoulder. Continue the clip for another eight seconds with the same LoRAs attached: the stillness breaks and she turns away from the light.

items.title: Continue a clip: fox-ear costume in crimson lamplight
items.alt: A woman in fox ears, a black silk robe and long gloves kneels on a velvet rug in a crimson room beside a table lamp, a plush fox tail curled behind her.
items.note: Continued with no LoRAs at all, to show the join on its own terms: she rises off her knees, a plush tail sweeps a slow arc across the rug behind her, a gloved hand gathers the robe closed, and she turns fully to camera. Deep crimson lamplight and film grain have to carry across the seam unchanged.

input.prompt: Continuing the same unbroken take: she rises up from her knees, the plush fox tail sweeping in a slow arc across the velvet rug behind her, gathers the black silk robe closed with one gloved hand and turns fully toward the camera, the tail settling against her leg; she tilts her head and holds the look. One continuous move with no cut, deep crimson lamp light, soft shadows, film grain.

items.title: End an extended clip on a settled hold for the next join
items.alt: A woman in a long dark coat stands at a wall of rain-streaked windows at night, city lights blurred beyond, and turns her head back over her shoulder.
items.note: A final segment that ends on a settled pose so a further extension stays possible.

input.prompt: She stops at the top of the stairs, turns her head back toward the crypt and holds still as the candles steady behind her. Camera locked.

items.title: First and last frame: a wolf-eared glance back in moonlight
items.alt: A woman with wolf ears, seen from behind in a moonlit forest, turns her bare shoulders and looks back over her shoulder with glowing gold eyes.
items.note: Both ends are supplied. `image_url` opens on a back turned to camera and `last_image_url` fixes the frame it has to arrive at, leaving the model only the turn between them. Pinning the ending is what makes a reveal commissionable: you approve the final look as a still first and then buy the movement. `duration_seconds` is exactly 5 or 8, so the two frames carry the pacing rather than a slider.

input.prompt: Start on her back, wolf ears and bare shoulders in moonlight, and end on the supplied final frame: she looks back over her shoulder, irises gone gold. Bare back and wolf ears in the moonlight, shoulder blades shifting as she turns. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, moon silver and forest black.

items.title: Dawn gym cooldown: stretch, shoulder roll, catch a breath
items.alt: A woman lowers her leg off a gym bench at dawn, rolls her shoulders back and straightens up, wiping sweat from her collarbone as low window light moves across the concrete behind her.
items.note: The exact request behind the clip on this page, generated from the opening frame shown beside it.

input.prompt: She lowers her leg off the bench, rolls her shoulders back and straightens up, wiping sweat from her collarbone with the back of her wrist, chest rising as she catches her breath. Dawn light shifts across the concrete, dust drifting in the beam.

items.title: Locked-camera bedroom shot: one slow pace closer, then a smile
items.alt: A woman in an open white shirt leans across a dark bed toward the camera, fingertip at her lip, then breaks into a slow half smile; lamp glow and a blue window behind.
items.note: The camera never moves and the distance changes anyway: she crawls one slow pace toward the viewer, her weight shifting onto the reaching hand and the open shirt sliding further off her shoulder. Warm lamp on the left against a cold window behind is the only lighting instruction, and the frame supplies the rest.

input.prompt: She crawls one slow pace closer toward the viewer, weight shifting onto the reaching hand, the open white shirt sliding further down off her shoulder. She draws her fingertip away from her lip, tips her head to the side and holds the viewer's gaze, then breaks into a slow half smile. Her hair swings forward. Warm lamp glow on the left, cold blue window behind, no camera move, shallow focus, quiet room tone.

items.title: Steam and knees above the waterline of a green bathtub
items.alt: Two pairs of knees rise above the waterline of a green enamel bathtub as steam curls off the water.
items.note: Everything of interest sits on one horizontal line, and the brief says so outright: what is below the waterline stays there. Writing an exclusion into the prompt is more reliable than framing around it, because the camera does not move here and the constraint has to hold for the whole clip. `duration_seconds` is 5, 10 or 15; steam and a shifting reflection are slow enough to justify the middle one.

input.prompt: Cast: two women. The camera stays on the knees and the waterline. Two pairs of knees cross above the bathtub waterline, steam curling off, the water's reflection shifting on the tiles. Steam curls off wet knees and shoulders; one knee slides against the other under the surface. Everything below the surface stays in the water. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, tile green and steam white.

items.title: Rooftop pool rise at blue hour, slicking hair back
items.alt: A swimmer rises out of a rooftop infinity pool at blue hour, water running off her shoulders as she slicks her wet hair back with both hands and opens her eyes toward camera, city towers glowing behind.
items.note: The exact request behind the clip on this page, generated from the opening frame shown beside it.

input.prompt: She rises further out of the water, sheets of it running off her shoulders and swimsuit, slicks her wet hair straight back with both hands and opens her eyes toward camera, droplets scattering. Blue-hour city towers glow behind, slow-motion water detail, ambient pool lap and distant traffic.

items.title: POV: slatted morning light moving across stockinged legs
items.alt: First-person view down a red satin bed at legs in black lace-top stockings, bars of light from a window blind moving across them.
items.note: A whole clip built from two tiny movements: toes flexing into silk and one knee straightening, with the sheets sliding under them. The light does the rest — slatted bars creeping across as the blind stirs — and the camera is a handheld point-of-view sway rather than a move.

input.prompt: Her toes flex and hook deeper into the silk, one knee slowly straightening, the sheets sliding and rippling under her legs. The slatted bars of light creep across her thighs as the blind stirs in the draught. Handheld point-of-view sway, warm red and gold, quiet morning room tone.

One turns in the water and moves behind the other. The front one tips her head back onto the other's shoulder and they turn their faces together. Framed from behind and above the shoulder line, the water surface holding steady at chest height the whole time. The bath swells against the green enamel, steam tearing and closing between their faces. Slow push in over the rim. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.

items.title: Close-up: silk drifting across a bare back in low gold light
items.alt: Close-up of a woman’s bare back and shoulder on a dim beach as a length of cream silk drifts across it in the wind.
items.note: `audio_url` supplies the track instead of generating one, and the brief is written to it: fabric drawn slowly across the body, uncovering and covering in turn, at the pace the music sets. Bringing your own audio is the difference between a clip that has sound and a clip that is cut to something. Turn `generate_audio` off when you do this, or you pay for a pass you will discard.

input.prompt: Cast: one woman. The camera stays on her as the silk crosses her. Silk is drawn slowly across the body by the draught; cut to the supplied slow music track. The silk drags across a bare shoulder, the waist and the whole line of the spine in turn; very close. Cinematic, very shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, low gold light.

items.title: Showgirl checks the mirror backstage, then turns to camera
items.alt: A showgirl in a fringed emerald sequin leotard finishes adjusting a shoulder strap at a bulb-lit backstage mirror, then turns her head to camera and raises an eyebrow before stepping out of frame.
items.note: The exact request behind the clip on this page, generated from the opening frame shown next to it.

input.prompt: She finishes adjusting the sequin strap, checks herself in the bulb-lit mirror, then turns her head to camera and raises one eyebrow before stepping out of frame toward the stage. Bulbs flicker, feathers stir in the draft, smoke drifts, muffled orchestra and applause building behind the wall.

items.title: Night dune: a sheet of indigo silk thrown into the wind
items.alt: A woman in a dark slip dress throws a huge sheet of indigo silk overhead on a desert dune at night, a lantern at her feet and the Milky Way above.
items.note: Several metres of loose silk thrown overhead and turned under, on a dune, at night, in wind. Large soft fabric is where most video models tear or freeze, and there are three other moving things around it — sand streaming off the crest, a guttering lantern flame and her long shadow across the ripples.

input.prompt: She sweeps the huge sheet of indigo silk down and across in front of her, then throws it back up so it billows overhead and fills the sky, turning under it with her head tipped back. Sand streams off the crest of the dune in the wind and the lantern flame gutters, throwing her shadow long across the ripples. Slow arc around her, starfield steady above, wind and snapping fabric.

items.title: A gust pulls silk off the shoulder, the camera follows the fabric
items.alt: A gust drags cream silk off a woman’s bare shoulder and back on a beach at dusk, then blows it back across her as she turns her head toward the light.

input.prompt: The draught drags the silk off her in one continuous pull, baring the whole slope of the shoulder and the line of the spine as the fabric slips away, then a second gust throws it back across her hip. She turns her head toward the light as the silk settles against her arm. The camera slides slowly along the body following the silk. Low gold light, dust turning in the beam, very shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.

items.title: Moon pool two silhouettes
items.note: `width` and `height` are given as exact pixels, `1440` by `2560` here, rather than as a named ratio, so the frame arrives at the size it will be used at with no resample in between. `enable_prompt_expansion` is left off, which is already its default: the brief is written as pure backlight and outline, and an expander that helpfully adds detail would fill in exactly the shapes this composition is withholding. Sigil light on the water is then the only colour in frame.

input.prompt: Cast: one man and one woman. Cinematic film still, a moonlit spirit spring at night. Two wet silhouettes stand at the water's edge in near-total backlight, reduced to pure outline, water tracking down the line of the waist; glowing sigils drift on the water surface and cast faint light upward. 65mm, shallow depth of field, heavy grain, moon silver and spirit cyan, restrained and tasteful.

items.title: Backlit curtain shadow
items.note: Nothing of the subject is rendered at all — only a shape thrown onto a linen curtain by candles on the far side, with a wax-pooled saucer sharp in the near foreground. The whole image lives or dies on one material: honey-gold light through a visible weave. Concealment, done properly, asks more of a model than exposure does.

input.prompt: Photograph shot from inside a dark bedroom looking at a floor-to-ceiling gauzy linen curtain lit from behind by a cluster of candles on the floor. The silhouette of an adult woman is projected onto the fabric from the far side: she stands in profile, arms raised, a loose robe around her shoulders, hair loose. Only the soft dark shape and a warm amber rim read through the cloth — pure backlit shadow play. A second smaller silhouette of a candle flame flickers at the lower left, wax pooling on a saucer in the sharp near foreground. Deep black room, honey-gold glow through the weave, visible linen texture, faint smoke drifting. Vertical composition, 50mm, shallow focus on the fabric. No text, no logos.

items.note: `width` `832` by `height` `1216` - an exact portrait rather than a named preset, which is how this endpoint takes its shape. `enable_prompt_expansion` stays off so the brief's single instruction survives intact: one hard light from one side, half the body, the rest dropped to black. The studs give that decision something measurable to land on, since each one either resolves as a small specular point or smears into the leather around it.

input.prompt: Cinematic portrait, low key. A man in a studded leather jacket worn open over bare skin, a single hard light from one side giving only half the body and dropping the rest to black; studs catch as small specular points. 85mm, shallow depth of field, heavy grain, black and oxblood palette, restrained and tasteful.

items.note: Written in the first person — my own crossed legs, my mug, my book — and shot on a 24mm from a low chair, so the near foreground stretches and the window stripes fall in hard bars across it. 1024x1536 is chosen because the frame is tall by nature; there is no crop here, the canvas was generated at that shape.

input.prompt: First-person point of view from a low chair looking down at my own crossed legs, morning sun cutting in through a tall window in hard bright stripes. Bare legs in sheer black lace-top stockings and black satin shorts, one foot in a slipper half hanging off the toes, a chipped ceramic coffee mug held between my knees, a book open on my thigh. Warm parquet floor, dust in the sunbeam, wide 24mm perspective, natural skin texture, 35mm colour film grain, unposed and lazy. Adult woman. No text, no logos.

items.title: Silk breathing locked
items.note: `camera_fixed` is the subject of this example. With the camera pinned, the only thing left to animate is the subject, so the brief asks for one motion — breathing under silk — and then states outright that nothing else in the frame moves. A locked frame is also the honest test of an image-to-video call: with no camera move to hide behind, any drift in the background is visible immediately.

input.prompt: Cast: one man and one woman. Locked-off camera, absolutely no movement: the silk sheet over the two of them rises and falls with their breathing, a bare shoulder and one arm outside it, nothing else in the frame moves. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, low warm lamp light.

items.title: Locked hotel sheets
items.note: The clip on this page, request and all: the opening still supplies the composition and the camisole, camera_fixed keeps the frame dead still, and the prompt only moves her ankles, her hand and her breathing.

input.prompt: Camera stays locked off. Her crossed ankles rock slowly and one foot flexes. She slides one hand out from behind her head and rests it on her stomach, her fingers tracing a slow circle on the camisole, while her other hand stays tucked behind her head. Her chest rises with a long breath. Nothing else in frame moves except the light shifting on the sheets.

items.title: Stocking and heel
items.note: A dolly that starts on a swinging heel at floor level and travels up to her hands, with everything outside one hard overhead key falling to black. Portrait framing is requested explicitly rather than left to the still, and audio is off because the shot is meant to be cut to a track.

input.prompt: Slow push-in along the floor from the dangling stiletto heel up toward her hands. She rolls the black stocking the rest of the way down to her ankle and slips it off over her toes, flexes her bare foot, then lets the patent heel swing twice on the toes of her other foot and drops it to the floor. She stays in the black lace outfit the whole time. Hard overhead key light, everything else stays black, extremely shallow focus. Continuous dolly, no cut.

items.title: Tail sweep arc
items.note: camera_fixed switched off against the locked shot at the top of this page: here the model chooses its own slow arc round to her left while a plush tail sweeps across the rug behind her. Fur that moves independently of the body is the detail that shows whether the arc is real parallax or a pan over a still.

input.prompt: The fluffy tail sweeps slowly across the rug behind her. She shifts her weight on her knees, tucks a strand of hair behind her ear and holds the camera's gaze over her shoulder, then breaks into a small laugh and looks away. Warm bedside lamp light, soft shadows moving on the rug. Slow arc around to her left.

items.title: Floodlit night pool, swimmers diving one after another
items.alt: At a floodlit outdoor pool at night, swimmers in competition suits crouch on the edge and dive in one after another, spray bursting white
items.note: A crowd load rather than a portrait one: bodies entering water one after another, a surface that never settles, and one figure hauling out at the near edge. Nothing here is a single tracked subject, which is what makes it a useful test of the fast tier. `image_url` sets the frame, and the sound is rendered in the same pass, so the impacts and the picture arrive already matched to each other.

input.prompt: Cast: a mixed crowd of men and women of different ages and skin tones. A night pool: one after another they hit the water, the splashes blowing up white in the floodlights, the surface never settling; someone hauls themselves out at the near edge, soaked. Wet swimwear clinging as one of them hauls out at the near edge, water running off the shoulders; close at the lip of the pool. Cinematic, heavy film grain, chlorine cyan and floodlight white.

items.title: Sunny balcony laundry turn with a grin
items.alt: A woman in a bikini top and denim cutoffs pinning a sheet to a washing line on a sunlit balcony, turning to camera with a grin
items.note: The clip on this page, request and all: the opening still supplies the balcony, the light and the swimwear, and the prompt does nothing but move her. Five seconds at 720p with audio on.

input.prompt: The sheet billows and drops as she pins it to the line, then she turns fully toward camera, pushes windblown hair off her face and grins. Bright midday sun, fabric snapping in the breeze, cicadas and distant sea.

items.title: Pillow pov lean
items.note: First person with the camera staying exactly where it is on the pillow: she comes down toward the lens, her hair falls around the edges of the frame and one hand reaches past it. Hair crossing the frame border is where a cheap render smears, so it is the thing to look at, not the eye contact.

input.prompt: First person point of view, the camera stays where it is on the pillow and does not move. She lowers herself closer toward the lens, her long hair falling forward around the edges of the frame, holds eye contact and smiles. She keeps the black lace top and the black satin robe on the whole time and stays fully dressed. Candlelight flickers behind her; the background stays black. Only her movement, no camera move, no cut.

items.title: Pool hall break shot in a black satin slip dress
items.alt: A woman in a black satin slip dress leans over a green pool table under hanging lamps, breaks the rack, then straightens up and looks toward the camera through drifting smoke
items.note: The camera holds still and the physics does the work: the cue strikes, the white ball cracks away across the felt, chalk goes on twice. The prompt rules music out and asks only for the click of the balls and room tone, which is the safer request whenever a scene could imply a soundtrack.

input.prompt: She strikes the break — the cue drives forward, the rack scatters across the felt, and she straightens up and looks at the lens as the balls settle. Smoke rolls through the lamp beam from the impact. Camera holds low at table height.

items.title: Robe tie pulled
items.note: A deliberately narrow frame: the brief states the crop twice — never above the ribs, never below the hip — so the render is held to one small area for the whole clip. Tight framing is the cheapest way to make the smallest tier look expensive, because the budget goes into a single moving element instead of a whole set. `image_url` supplies the frame and the prompt supplies only the one movement inside it.

input.prompt: Cast: two women. The camera stays on her waist and the hand at the belt, nothing above the ribs. Close on the waist only: another hand rests on the knotted belt of the bathrobe and stays there. The frame never goes above the ribs or below the hip. Cinematic, very shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, low warm light.

items.note: The clip on this page, request and all: the opening still supplies the kitchen, the shirt and the single light source, and the prompt only closes the door and walks her out. Five seconds at 720p with audio on.

input.prompt: She lowers the bottle, shuts the refrigerator door with her hip and the room drops to darkness except for a thin sliver of street light, then she pads barefoot out of frame. Static camera, cold blue to warm black, fridge hum and bare feet on tile.

items.title: Hand streak on a fogged shower glass
items.alt: Behind fogged shower glass, a woman in a black bikini drags her palm down the steamed pane, backlit by a bright window as steam rolls across the frame
items.note: Concealment doing the work: the body stays a soft outline behind fogged glass for the whole shot, and the only event is a palm dragged down leaving a clear streak that immediately re-fogs. Camera locked, backlight blown out, and the whole thing rests on one material behaving correctly.

input.prompt: Locked-off camera, no move. Steam keeps rolling across the frame and the glass fogs further. She presses her palm flat on the glass and drags it slowly downward, leaving one clear streak that immediately re-fogs, then turns her head and sweeps her wet hair across to the other shoulder. She keeps the black bikini on the whole time. Water runs down the outside of the glass, the backlight stays blown out and cold, and her body stays only a soft outline through the fog. No camera move, no cut.

items.title: Desert sunrise coffee from an open van door
items.alt: A woman sits in the open side door of a white van in a red crop top and flannel shirt, sipping from a mug as the sun rises over a desert of mesas
items.note: The one daylight clip here, and the one that asks the light itself to change: the sun keeps strengthening across the five seconds while steam curls off the mug and the marram grass moves. Everything else on this page is a single fixed source in the dark, which makes this the useful comparison.

input.prompt: She pulls the flannel closed against the cold, sips from the mug and lets her head tip back into the sunrise with her eyes closed. Steam off the mug catches the rim light; the sun climbs and the orange rim strengthens. Camera drifts slowly in from outside the van.

items.title: Velvet curtain turn 4k
items.note: Pure silhouette, which puts the whole burden on edge quality: there is no interior detail to hide behind, only an outline moving against backlight. That is why the brief belongs on an endpoint whose `resolution` reaches `4k` — the thing being judged is the contour. `image_url` sets the backlight and the frame, and the prompt states one movement and, more importantly, where it stops rather than letting it run to completion.

input.prompt: Cast: one woman. The camera stays on her silhouette as the curtain shifts around it. A silhouette turns behind a velvet curtain and the fabric sweeps across and catches there. Pure backlight, no detail beyond outline. Cinematic, heavy film grain, deep red-black.

items.title: Wiping a fogged bathroom mirror in a waffle robe
items.alt: A woman in a loosely tied waffle robe wiping a streak through a fogged bathroom mirror and leaning toward her reflection
items.note: The clip on this page, request and all: the opening still supplies the robe, the steam and the mirror, and the prompt does nothing but move her. Five seconds at 720p with audio on.

input.prompt: She wipes a wider streak through the fogged mirror, steam curling back across the glass, then leans in closer to her reflection and exhales, the robe slipping a little further off her shoulder. Slow push toward the mirror, warm vanity bulbs, water dripping.

items.title: Red-safelight darkroom with a dripping print
items.alt: Under a red darkroom safelight, a woman in an open shirt rocks a developer tray, then lifts a dripping print into the light and glances at the camera
items.note: A single-colour light source and almost nothing else: red safelight, a print lifted dripping out of the tray, chemical ripples throwing reflections onto the ceiling. Monochromatic scenes strip away the colour cues a model normally leans on, so this one is about whether shape and wet surfaces still read.

input.prompt: She rocks the developer tray with the tongs, then lifts the dripping print up into the red safelight and turns it to look at it, glancing sideways at the camera. The open shirt slides further off one shoulder. Slow dolly in, safelight steady, chemical ripples reflecting on the ceiling.

items.title: Library ladder, a pulled book and a plume of dust
items.alt: A woman in a cream blouse and dark skirt on a rolling library ladder pulls a heavy book from a high shelf, dust drifting through the window light as she turns and smiles
items.note: Adaptive framing, so a landscape still comes back in its own shape rather than cropped. The payload is the dust she blows off the top edge of the book: a cloud that has to turn and glitter in a shaft of low sun, which is a far harder ask than moving a person.

input.prompt: She pulls a heavy book from the top shelf, releasing a plume of dust that ignites in the window shaft, and looks down over her shoulder toward the lens as the ladder rolls a few inches along its rail. Camera cranes slowly up to meet her.

items.title: Velvet curtain spiral turn in red backlight
items.alt: A backlit silhouette turns inside a red velvet stage curtain, the fabric wound across her front and her bare shoulders catching a rim of light

input.prompt: The velvet curtain sweeps across her as she turns inside it, wrapping her body in one continuous spiral of fabric, then billows out behind her as she steps toward the light. Her bare shoulders and the line of her back come into the glow; the curtain stays wound across her front as she moves. Backlight flares through the gap and dims. Slow push toward the silhouette, velvet rippling the whole time. Cinematic, heavy film grain, deep red and black, glowing rim light.

items.title: Two women rising from a misty outdoor hot spring
items.alt: Two women in a steaming outdoor hot spring at dusk, first facing the camera with the water at their shoulders, then seen from behind with bare backs above the waterline
items.note: A single take built on a continuous change of state rather than an action: a waterline receding, steam closing behind it. Nothing cuts, so the brief describes one process and its order — first one figure, then the other. `duration_seconds` reaches thirty on this endpoint, which is what makes a slow process worth writing out, and `last_image_url` is available when the ending needs pinning rather than describing.

input.prompt: Cast: two women. The camera stays on their backs as they rise, and stops there. In the mist of an outdoor hot spring at dusk, first one and then the other rises only until the waterline reaches the small of the back and no further; they hold there, steam closing over the surface behind them. Nothing below the waterline ever leaves the water. Locked framing. Cinematic, heavy film grain, steam white and rock grey, restrained and tasteful.

items.title: Face pressed close behind steamed shower glass
items.alt: Behind fogged shower glass in a dark bathroom, a woman drags her palm down the pane and leans in until her face comes into focus through the clear streak
items.note: There is no camera-lock field on this endpoint, so the lock is written into the prompt - three flat refusals to pull back, widen or reangle. Audio is on and no track can be supplied, so the water and the single breath are written too.

input.prompt: Her palm drags straight down the fogged glass, carving one long clear streak from the wiped patch to the bottom edge, and her fingertips lift away. She immediately steps forward and leans into that clear streak: her face arrives close to the glass and comes into sharp focus through it, wet skin and lashes clearly visible, water beading and running around her cheek. She holds there, eyes level with the lens, and breathes out against the glass so a small bloom of fog spreads and fades. The framing stays tight on the glass panel the entire time. Do not pull back, do not widen the shot, do not change the camera angle. Running water, muffled room tone, one slow breath.

items.title: Silk slip turn at a night hotel window
items.alt: A woman in an ivory silk slip turning from a floor-to-ceiling hotel window at night, city lights behind her
items.note: The clip on this page, request and all: the opening still supplies the wardrobe and the window, and the prompt does nothing but move her. Five seconds at 720p with audio on.

input.prompt: She turns slowly from the window toward camera, the silk slip catching the city light as it moves, one hand trailing along the glass, then she tilts her head and holds the look. Subtle handheld drift, warm lamp against cool skyline, quiet room tone.

items.title: First-person: pulled by the hand through a night market
items.alt: A first-person shot of a woman in black satin taking the viewer's hand and running through a neon night market, laughing back over her shoulder
items.note: First person, handheld: the viewer's own bare feet sit in the foreground and she takes the hand held out toward her, tugs it and leans in until her face fills more of the frame. The still already put the camera in the bed, so the prompt only has to say what she does with the person holding it.

input.prompt: She closes her hand around the viewer's and pulls, breaking into a run and towing the camera after her through the neon stalls, laughing back over her shoulder once. Handheld first-person motion, neon streaking past, crowd noise and sizzling griddles.

items.title: Backless gown gliding up an opera house staircase
items.alt: A woman in a backless black velvet gown and long gloves climbs a marble opera house staircase, glancing back over her shoulder as the train drags behind her
items.note: Almost the whole frame is black with one chandelier holding the highlights, and the shot is a following dolly up marble stairs with a velvet train dragging behind. Heavy fabric in motion and a moving light source together are the expensive part; the audio is left on for hall reverb rather than music.

input.prompt: She holds the look back over her bare shoulder, then turns and continues up two more steps, the velvet train dragging heavily behind her across the marble, her gloved hand sliding along the brass banister. The chandelier flares a little brighter and the gilt catches, deep shadows swinging across the wall. Slow dolly following her up the stairs, hushed hall reverb, no music.

The two women rise toward camera only as far as the collarbone, water sheeting off their shoulders, and the steam banks thick across the surface in front of them. One slides behind the other and wraps both arms around her from behind, her forearm crossing high over the chest; they settle cheek to cheek and hold the look into the lens while the water swells and slaps the rocks. Slow push in on their faces and shoulders, framed from the collarbone up the whole time. Dusk light on wet skin, drifting snow beyond. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.

items.title: Vhs grain two on bed
items.note: This endpoint ships with a LoRA preset already attached, and `loras` lets you re-weight up to three of them per call instead of accepting the baked-in strength. The brief asks for a whole-frame change of medium — scan lines, chroma bleed, tape wobble that comes and goes — which is the kind of instruction a preset carries better than prose. `preset` stays on `tuned`; drop it to `original` when you want the untuned behaviour back.

input.prompt: Cast: one man and one woman. The camera stays on the two of them from the shoulders up, and never tilts below the collarbone. Push the whole frame to 1990s VHS: two people sitting at the edge of an unmade bed in low lamplight, one bare shoulder and a sheet held at the chest, her head tipping onto his shoulder; scan lines, chroma bleed and tape wobble crawl across the image. Handheld, low light, heavy analogue grain, restrained and tasteful.

items.title: Neon rooftop
items.note: One LoRA override at strength 1 plus a movement note - the shape to start from before adjusting anything else.

input.prompt: The glowing cyan circuits along her arms and spine pulse in sequence as she completes the turn, holographic billboards flickering behind her, rain hissing on the rooftop. Slow arc around her silhouette, volumetric neon fog, synth bass swell.

items.title: Gouache poster pier
items.note: No LoRA overrides at all - just the default tuned preset - to show where the baseline sits: a flat 1950s gouache poster has to stay flat for five seconds instead of sliding into photographic rendering. Watch the brush texture and the screen-print grain hold while the canopy ripples and the sandal swings.

input.prompt: The painted illustration comes alive without losing its flat printed look: the striped umbrella canopy ripples in the sea breeze, her hair lifts and the gulls glide across the turquoise sky. She lowers her sunglasses with one finger, glances over the top of them at the camera and smiles, then swings the dangling sandal off her toe. The sea sparkles behind the bathing huts. Gentle slow push in, gouache brush texture and screen-print grain held stable throughout.

items.title: Strength sweep
items.note: Three seconds at 480p with the seed pinned and scale pushed to 2, which is how you find where a LoRA starts taking over.

input.prompt: She drives up out of the squat, the bar flexing on her shoulders, chalk dust bursting off her hands into the lamp beam, and racks the bar with a heavy metallic clang before straightening and exhaling at the lens. Handheld, slight shake on the rack, haze rolling through the light.

items.title: Mirror steam no prompt
items.note: No prompt was sent with this one, and that is the demonstration. `prompt` is optional on this endpoint, so the opening frame becomes the entire instruction and the model extends what is already in it rather than being told what to add. It is the right test for a slow, self-evident change like fog creeping across a mirror, and it costs nothing to try before you spend a sentence. `duration_seconds` reaches twenty here.

items.title: Rain car
items.note: A single still plus a movement note - the turn, the hair, the wipers are written; the wet shirt and the framing came from the frame.

input.prompt: She turns further toward the driver's seat, wet shirt clinging as she moves, pushes a soaked strand of hair back and mouths something with a tired smile. Rain streams down the windscreen, neon reflections crawl across the glass, wipers sweep once.

items.title: Hearth chaise heels
items.note: A locked-off camera and everything else moving: the firelight flickering, the ankles re-crossing, the hem drawn a little higher. The prompt says explicitly that the camera does not move, which is what keeps a five-second beat readable instead of busy.

input.prompt: The fire surges and the orange light flickers across her bare legs and the green velvet. She uncrosses her ankles and re-crosses them the other way, the pointed heels tipping, then slides her free hand slowly up the black silk robe and draws the hem a little higher on her thigh before letting it settle. She tips her head back against the chaise, keeps her eyes on the camera and one corner of her mouth lifts. Locked-off camera, no camera move, logs cracking and popping.

items.title: Drive in bonnet
items.note: The vertical cut on this page, and a lighting case rather than an action one: a blank projector beam pulsing brighter and dimmer over her face while headlights cross behind. The output shape comes from the opening frame, not from a field — there is no aspect ratio on this endpoint.

input.prompt: The projector beam flickers and the blank screen pulses brighter then dimmer, washing her face in shifting blue light. She uncrosses her ankles on the warm bonnet, pushes herself up on one elbow, tips the paper cup back and grins toward the camera, then pulls the striped blanket up over one knee. Headlights sweep past behind her and the dusk sky deepens. Locked-off wide shot, no camera move, crickets and a distant tinny speaker.

She presses both palms to the fogged glass and drags them slowly down, carving two clear streaks, then steps in and leans her forehead against the mirror, rolling her shoulders back and letting the wet hair fall away from her neck. Her reflection sharpens through the streaks and her eyes open toward the lens. The towel stays knotted above the chest throughout. Steam rolls across the ceiling, water beads and runs down the glass, the bulbs flicker. Slow push toward the mirror. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.

items.title: Steam room turn
items.note: One movement, described once: a single turn, with steam disturbed where the body passes and closing again behind it. The prompt is optional on this endpoint, but a short one earns its place when the motion has a direction and an end point instead of being ambient. `resolution` runs from `480p` up to `1080p`, so the same call can be tried cheaply for blocking and then re-run at the tier you intend to deliver.

input.prompt: She turns in the steam room, water beading down the shoulder blades, the steam swirling where she moves and closing again behind her. Water beads and runs the length of her spine as she turns, the towel slipping at the hip; close. Slow, single turn. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, warm cedar and white vapour.

items.title: Red neon cigarette smoke by the window blinds
items.alt: Night interior: a woman on an apartment windowsill exhaling smoke against rain-streaked glass while a red neon sign pulses across her face
items.note: A single still plus a movement note. The smoke, the neon cycle and the head turn are written; everything identifying came from the frame.

input.prompt: She exhales a slow plume of smoke against the rain-streaked glass, the neon sign outside pulses red across her face, and she turns her head toward camera without changing expression. Blind shadows creep, rain runs down the window, distant traffic.

items.title: Pov glove tap
items.note: First person with a locked camera: she comes in until she fills the frame and presses a gloved fingertip against the lens. The prompt keeps naming the harness, the camisole, the opera gloves and the choker in every beat, which is how you keep the wardrobe the same from the first beat to the last.

input.prompt: First person point of view, the camera never moves. She leans in toward the lens until her face and shoulders fill the frame, reaches out and presses one gloved fingertip against the lens, holds eye contact, then tilts her head and smiles. She keeps the black leather harness, satin camisole, long opera gloves and choker on the whole time. The hard overhead light rakes her collarbone and the background stays pure black.

items.title: Misting plants in a sunlit greenhouse
items.alt: In a humid glasshouse full of banana leaves and ferns, a woman in a white cotton sundress sprays a brass mister, then wipes her brow and turns her face up to the light
items.note: The daylight case, and the vertical one. Everything else on this page works in the dark; here the suggestion comes from humidity — mist hanging in the green light, damp linen, a wrist across the forehead — under a glass roof at noon. Same five seconds, same single frame, opposite end of the exposure range.

input.prompt: She squeezes the brass mister twice and a fine haze drifts through the green light; the big banana leaves nod under the water. She wipes the back of her wrist across her forehead, pushes a damp strand of hair off her neck and turns her face up into the sunlight coming through the glass roof, breathing out. Slow push in, humid air, droplets falling from the ferns, birdsong outside.

She rolls her shoulders back and stretches upward in the cedar heat, the towel at her hips sliding loose and dropping away out of frame, water running the length of her bare spine. She turns her head to look back over one shoulder into the lens, then steps forward into the billowing steam. The vapour boils up around her and swallows the far wall. Slow handheld drift following her, warm cedar light, condensation crawling down the glass. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.

items.title: Neon street
items.note: The wide shape and the neon are both in the prompt: this lineage reads lighting tags as readily as wardrobe tags.

input.prompt: score_9, score_8_up, 1girl, solo, silver twin tails, oversized varsity jacket, denim shorts, standing on a neon-lit city street at night, rain reflections, looking at viewer, cinematic lighting, detailed background

items.title: Cafe window
items.note: A deliberately plain brief. Tag prompting does not need drama to hold together.

input.prompt: score_9, score_8_up, 1boy, solo, short black hair, glasses, knit sweater, sitting by a cafe window with coffee, warm afternoon light, bokeh, calm expression, detailed background

items.title: Silver knight
items.note: Armour detail is where SDXL checkpoints usually fall apart at off-ratio sizes; this is a native one.

input.prompt: score_9, score_8_up, 1girl, solo, long white hair, ornate silver armor, red cape, holding a longsword, standing on castle ramparts at dawn, dramatic sky, full body, detailed armor

items.title: Autumn shrine
items.note: Two figures in one frame, to show the model holds a scene together and not just a single portrait.

input.prompt: score_9, score_8_up, 2girls, red and white miko outfits, sweeping fallen maple leaves at a shrine, autumn morning mist, stone lanterns, wide shot, detailed background

items.title: Wet hair close no prompt
items.note: Sent with no prompt at all. The still is the entire brief — `prompt` is optional on this endpoint, and an extreme close-up with one obvious physical process already in it is exactly the case where a written instruction adds nothing the frame does not imply. `movement_amplitude` is the control that matters when there is no text: leave it on `auto`, or raise it when the frame needs more than a breath of motion.

items.title: Ryokan pour
items.note: A single still plus a movement note. The pour, the look to camera and the shoulder are written; everything identifying came from the frame.

input.prompt: She finishes pouring, sets the flask down and lifts her eyes to camera with a small smile, steam rising from the cup, the yukata sliding a fraction lower on her shoulder. Paper shoji glow, evening cicadas, very slow push-in.

items.title: Booth heel drop
items.note: A chain of small movements that all have to stay attached to one body: a stiletto rolls off pointed toes and drops, that leg draws down and crosses the other, a hand pulls a fallen strap back up. Limb continuity across a low tracking dolly is what this family is actually good at, and this is the shot that shows it.

input.prompt: She rolls the black stiletto off her pointed toes and it drops onto the velvet, then draws that leg down along the back of the booth and crosses it over the other. Her other hand pulls the fallen strap back up onto her bare shoulder and she holds the look into the lens, lifting her chin. The red neon on the right breathes brighter and the amber sconce flickers. Slow low tracking dolly moving in past the edge of the table, quiet bar room tone.

items.title: Wheel and hands
items.note: The vertical clip here, and the one where the hands are the performance: the wall of clay rises under her fingers, thumbs open the rim, one wet hand comes off and leaves a grey streak on her cheek. Continuous fine hand work is the failure mode most video models never get past, so scrub it slowly.

input.prompt: The wheel keeps spinning and the clay wall rises under her hands, then she opens the rim with her thumbs and it flares outward. She lifts one wet hand off, wipes her forearm across her cheek leaving a grey streak, and glances up at the camera with a small smile before going back to the pot. Slip water runs down the wheel head. Slow push in, wheel hum and wet clay.

She lifts her face slowly out of the fall of wet hair, water running off her chin and throat, and opens her eyes straight into the lens. Her lips part on an exhale and she tilts her head, hair peeling away from her cheek in wet strands, one bare shoulder rolling forward into frame. Slow push in, water still dripping, cold blue light, condensation in the air. Cinematic, very shallow depth of field, heavy film grain.
